metadata.question: On August 3, 2025, were there more than 120 fires active in Saskatchewan, Canada?

data.raw_code: The question asks: "On August 3, 2025, were there more than 120 fires active in Saskatchewan, Canada?" Key considerations: 1. Data source: Need active fire detection data. Best sources are: - MODIS Active Fire Data (MODIS/006/MCD14DL) - daily global fire detection - VIIRS Active Fire Data (NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14A1) - higher resolution 2. Date: August 3, 2025 (single day) 3. Location: Saskatchewan, Canada (need polygon geometry) 4. Logic: Count number of fire detections (pixels classified as fire) Data quality considerations: - August 3, 2025 is in the future relative to current data (as of 2024). MODIS/VIIRS may not have data yet. - We need to check collection size first - If empty, try fallback options (different collection, or widen date range) - Need to filter for fire confidence levels (high confidence fires) Steps: 1. Define Saskatchewan boundary 2. Get fire data for August 3, 2025 3. Count fire detections 4. Compare with threshold 120 Important: The question asks for "active fires" - each fire detection pixel may represent multiple actual fires, but we'll count detections as proxy. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const saskatchewan = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Saskatchewan')); const date = '2025-08-03'; const startDate = ee.Date(date); const endDate = startDate.advance(1, 'day'); // 2. Data Acquisition - Try VIIRS first (higher resolution) let fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14A1') .filterBounds(saskatchewan) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); let collectionSize = fireCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`VIIRS Collection size for ${date}: ${collectionSize}`); // If no VIIRS data, try MODIS if (collectionSize === 0) { fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14DL') .filterBounds(saskatchewan) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); collectionSize = fireCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Collection size for ${date}: ${collectionSize}`); } // If still no data, try widening date range (±1 day) if (collectionSize === 0) { const widerStart = startDate.advance(-1, 'day'); const widerEnd = endDate.advance(1, 'day'); fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14A1') .filterBounds(saskatchewan) .filterDate(widerStart, widerEnd); collectionSize = fireCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`VIIRS Collection size for ±1 day: ${collectionSize}`); } // If no data after fallbacks, output C1 if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Count fire pixels // Use 'FireMask' band where values 6-9 indicate fires (low to very high confidence) const fireMask = fireCollection.select('FireMask'); // Create binary mask for fires (values >= 6) const fireBinary = fireMask.map(function(image) { return image.gte(6).selfMask(); }); // Count fire pixels over the region const fireCount = fireBinary.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: saskatchewan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('FireMask').getInfo(); console.log(`Fire detections on ${date}: ${fireCount}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (fireCount === null || fireCount === undefined || fireCount < 0) { console.log("C3"); } else if (fireCount > 120) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
